catalogue.title: Cyclops & Sheep
catalogue.briefing: Carry two stranded frogs to safety, rescue their companions, and outwit the Cyclops guarding the road home.
objectiveSummaries: Carry the stranded frogs across the river
Craft a sheep disguise and fool the Cyclops

implementation.summary: Tivara carries two stranded frogs to a safe pond, rescues captive companions, survives Corpy attacks, and crafts a sheep disguise to pass a roaming Cyclops.

phasePlan.description: Introduce the riverland rescue and establish protected mission actors.
Teach selection, movement, carrying, and safe drop-off.
Reveal and clear the guarded bridge.
Free two captive Tivara and convert them into player companions.
Reveal the patrol and teach a recoverable stealth route.
Recover tusks and the lost shears from the boar clearing.
Shear the protected flock and secure enough wool.
Defend the disguise materials from a difficulty-scaled Corpy counterattack.
Consume the collected mission items and disguise the rescued party.
Cross the Cyclops detection zone safely and reach the far road.
Remove the disguise, conclude the rescue, and unlock the next mission.

checkpointCandidates.after: both stranded frogs reach the large pond
both captive Tivara join the player
the tusks and lost shears are recovered
the sheep are shorn and the Corpy attack begins
the party sheep disguise is equipped

mechanics: Mission-scoped carry and safe drop interactions
Owner conversion for rescued quest actors
Difficulty-specific Cyclops proximity detection with fail-forward recovery
Protected and recoverable frogs, sheep, and mission items
Deterministic item consumption and reversible party disguise
coopNotes: The mission currently exposes one synchronized human participant slot.
Carry, rescue, item, objective, and disguise state are shared for a later co-op override.
missingAssets: Final voice acting and bespoke sheep-disguise character art
tests: Complete the main path on every difficulty and round trip all six checkpoints
Complete the nest objective before its story phase and retain the optional reward
Trigger Cyclops detection and recover without failing the mission
Verify protagonist defeat, cinematic skip equivalence, replay safety, item restoration, and disguise cleanup
definitionOfDone: The full authored route is playable without debug fact mutation
Critical quest actors and collected ingredients cannot permanently softlock progression
Checkpoint restoration preserves carry, conversion, encounters, items, disguise, cinematics, and rewards
The next story mission unlocks exactly once after an eligible victory

implementationTodos.description: Attach final voice assets without changing deterministic dialogue or cinematic state.
Replace the opacity treatment after bespoke sheep-disguise art is approved.
